name: Reinvigorating America's Human Space Exploration Program
effect: Amends Presidential Policy Directive-4 (2010), articulating a direct call for space missions beyond LEO, specifically to the Moon and eventually to Mars and other celestial bodies.
alignment_notes: Calls for more space missions but does not provide a space sustainability framework.
sponsors: Scott Pace (Deputy Assistant to the President & Executive Secretary of the National Space Council)
